prompts.bludgeon: Create a production 2D hand-drawn game VFX animation sprite sheet, landscape 1536x1024, exactly 2 rows by 3 columns, six equal square cells, chronological left to right then top to bottom. Each cell 512x512, same fixed camera, action centered about local (256,256), all pixels of every effect including sparks fit inside central 82% of cell with solid margin. Entire background 100% flat solid chroma-key MAGENTA #FF00FF. No grid lines, borders, text, labels, character, weapon, enemy, floor, scenery, UI, cast shadow, or rectangular backdrop. Clean HD ink-and-cel fantasy game effects, NOT pixel art. Bold lively brush silhouettes, deliberate sharp negative spaces, varied thick/thin ink contours, large graphic light/dark masses. Palette amber #D9A441, warm pale #E0C1AC brightest, muted burnt ochre, charcoal #1B1612, smoky slate grey. No white, no pink in the effects, no gradients into the magenta, no blur, no generic smooth geometric curves. All six cells use same scale and origin; effects should genuinely evolve frame to frame, not repeat rotated copies. SUBJECT: ONE continuous massive ceramic-kiln shattering impact, diagonal downward cut upper-left toward center. This is a detached special attack FX, no axe drawn. A narrow fast cutting streak punctures a compact angular bright contact star and explodes into sharp broken glazed ceramic plates, bold expanding hooked ink shock shapes and dense short dust curls. The impact contact is always cell center. FRAME1 razor diagonal streak approaching center with small compressed sparks. FRAME2 huge explosive jagged amber/pale contact burst, diagonal slash, crown of ceramic shards ejecting outward. FRAME3 burst opens into asymmetric torn blades and fan-shaped shards, strong black negative wedges. FRAME4 primary light breaking into fragments, outward speed strokes and curling grey dust. FRAME5 dispersed dark ceramic shards with amber edges and sparse dust wisps. FRAME6 few small cooling shards and curling smoke remnants; very sparse, no new burst. Broad explosive energetic silhouette, heavy weight, not tree branches or lightning, no straight ribbon.
